decisions.reason: Underground LHD loaders sit at the core of the firm's announced direction in mining equipment and represent substantial engineering and certification investment, and with only one year on the market any weak results can still be attributed to ramp-up, so management will persist.

Underground dump trucks were launched alongside the loaders as part of a visible, publicly presented mining vehicle line, and dropping them after a single year would write off heavy development costs and expose the launch decision as a mistake, so the firm keeps them.
